Nit, can we alphabetize this list?

non-nit, are we sure we need all of these?

CONFIG_USB_DWC2 should be enabled with CONFIG_USB_ASPEED_UDC for example?

CONFIG_USB_CONFIGFS_ETH and CONFIG_USB_CONFIGFS_ECM seem like competing options?

I'm not sure how much I care, this can probably merge, but would be good if you know.

Hi Ed. I removed some unnecessary config options and added some more dependencies in for clarity on what the feature requires based on the kernelconfig.io dependency tree. 
Hope this is good to push in now.
Pretty sure we don't need xtrace on?

meta-fii/meta-kudo/recipes-kudo/network/usb-network/usb_network.sh
Is setting the serial number required?
I think these should be Linux and Ethernet/ECM gadget?
